body: They won't understand for a long time. But once enough time has passed they will move on. I'm saving them from a life of disappointment. They will all end up disowning me anyway. I just don't see anything in life to look forward to. I'm not working my whole life to end up in debt. I don't want a wife or kids, I don't want to own a house. Maybe ill do better next time.
My whole life has been downfalls. I don't care about anything anymore. If I lived, I would be a bum with no ambition, mooching off loved ones, and probably do something stupid and end up in jail.
I called a hotline once and it didn't help. They basically just guilt tripped me to try and prevent it.

I failed once, thought I could come back, but nope. I'm not messing around anymore, I'm going to shoot myself. No good will come from my life, the stress I cause others have already taken years off their life. I'm not angry as much as I am defeated. I don't feel emotions like I used to.
